jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Eko Health builds devices and software that help clinicians detect heart and lung disease earlier. We’re looking for a Manager, Cost Accounting & Procure-to-Pay, remote in the US on Pacific hours, to own two things at the center of our business: what it costs us to put a device in a clinician’s hands, and how we pay for everything that gets it there.This is a build role. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, you will set Eko’s costing methodology and defend it to our auditors, own inventory valuation and reserves, run landed cost end to end, close COGS each month, and run procure-to-pay from purchase order to payment. You will partner with Supply Chain, Sales Operations, and FP&A, and your margin analysis will reach the executive team. You inherit a working foundation and a lot of room to make it better.A few things make this role unusual. Eko does not run a factory: devices are built by contract manufacturers and bought as finished goods, so cost is purchase price plus landed cost, and inventory sits with partners we cannot walk into. Hardware is sold alongside subscription software, so the margin story is blended. And this is a hands-on manager role with no direct reports to start: you provide review oversight to our offshore transactional team while personally owning the higher-judgment accounting, reconciliations, close, and conclusions. This role owns content planning across the full reverse mortgage decision system: homeowners, mortgage brokers and key influencers, particularly adult children. Grounded in the reverse mortgage growth strategy, the Content Manager will translate complex product information into audience- and stage-specific content that builds permission for homeowners, reassurance for families and confidence for brokers. jobs.title: Manager, Model Validation
jobs.description_text: The Work The Manager, Model Validation reports to the Director, Model Risk Management and supports the delivery of model validation activities across the Bank. The role executes validation procedures, contributes to validation strategies, and supports the effective management of model risk in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework and applicable regulatory requirements. The scope includes models used for credit and treasury risk management, including AIRB and IFRS 9 ECL, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, and stress testing approaches used to support ICAAP. The role works closely with model risk stakeholders and conducts detailed reviews of model methodologies, assumptions, intended use, limitations, inputs, implementation, and performance. Responsibilities include completing benchmark and outcome analyses, documenting issues and recommendations, drawing evidence-based conclusions, and preparing model validation reports in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF). The primary focus is the execution of model validation activities, with additional support provided for model governance activities such as regulatory self-assessments, annual attestations, and risk reporting.

You’ll lead our Accounts Payable team while rethinking the processes behind their work, identifying manual tasks, resolving bottlenecks, and implementing AI and automation that improve accuracy and help us scale. You’ll bring the accounting judgment to understand what should be automated, what controls need to stay in place, and how changes affect financial reporting and audit requirements. You’ll help define the path, working closely with Accounting, business teams, and systems partners to take improvements from initial opportunity through implementation, adoption, and measurable results. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Cruise
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Backend Engineer within our Maritime domain, you will lead the backend architecture and streaming services that process high-volume vessel tracking, port intelligence, and maritime trade flows. Working with core technologies including Python, PHP, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and ClickHouse, you will design scalable, highly available systems that transform raw maritime telemetry into real-time actionable insights for global shipping and commodity markets. Operating with high autonomy under a "you build it, you run it" engineering culture, you will play a crucial role in modernizing core services, elevating technical standards, and collaborating with cross-functional partners and client-facing technical teams.

jobs.title: Senior Biofuels Research Analyst
jobs.description_text: As a Senior US Biofuels Analyst, you will own and build Kpler’s fundamental supply and demand (S&D) research for US biofuels and feedstocks from the ground up. Covering renewable diesel, biodiesel, ethanol, SAF, and key agricultural feedstocks (UCO, tallow, soybean oil, corn), you will turn complex market balances into an authoritative industry benchmark. By connecting Kpler's agriculture and energy research desks, you will analyze the policy drivers, trade flows, and crush economics that shape the US biofuels landscape, delivering high-impact market intelligence that clients actively seek out.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst (Companies/Ownership)
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Data Analyst within our Data Platform team, you will be the subject matter expert behind Kpler’s company and ownership datasets. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, structure and ongoing development of company-level data, including ownership, management, operator and corporate hierarchy information. Your deep understanding of the maritime industry and its corporate landscape will help establish a reliable source of truth for asset ownership, supporting our wider data platform strategy and enabling other datasets, products and teams to build on consistent, trusted information. Starting with maritime companies, you will help expand our coverage over time to include other asset classes and related industries, such as ports, terminals, refineries, commodities and infrastructure. You will use your industry judgement to lead complex data investigations, identify gaps and drive improvements in data quality and coverage with a high degree of independence. While technical data skills are important, this role places particular emphasis on your industry expertise and ability to translate complex ownership structures into clear business rules and reliable data models. You will also collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Market Analysts and other Data Analysts to strengthen our data capabilities and support commercial and customer-facing teams.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Data Engineer on our Maritime Models team, you will take technical ownership of the core data pipelines and distributed storage architectures powering Kpler's vessel tracking and predictive analytics. You will design, scale, and optimize high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines that ingest raw maritime telemetry and transform it into actionable intelligence. Working with distributed NoSQL systems like Apache HBase at scale, your work directly ensures the freshness, accuracy, and reliability of the data models our global customers depend on.

jobs.description_text: Our Platform Engineering group builds internal tools for over a 100 Lendbuzz engineers in Boston & Tel Aviv.We treat the platform as a product: our engineers are our users, we actively collect their feedback, we measure whether what we built is impactful for the organization, and we continuously improve based on feedback and metrics. jobs.title: Senior Security Lead
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Senior Security Lead to partner closely with our CISO in driving Lendbuzz's security strategy and running the day-to-day of the security function. This role suits someone who combines strong technical depth with excellent communication skills and strong project management capabilities. You'll have broad scope, high visibility, and a direct impact on how security works at Lendbuzz.

jobs.title: Manager/Senior Manager, CMC Quality Control
jobs.description_text: Role Summary The Manager/Senior Manager, CMC Quality Control (QC) is responsible for providing strategic and operational oversight of QC activities supporting Lexeo's gene therapy programs. This role serves as a QC lead for external contract testing laboratories (CTLs), analytical lifecycle management (i.e., late-phase method validation), stability programs, release testing support, and analytical investigation activities. The individual will work closely with Analytical Development, Technical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, and external partners to ensure analytical methods, specifications, and testing programs support clinical development, process validation readiness, and future commercial requirements. This position requires technical expertise in analytical testing, preferably of AAV-based products, as well as demonstrated experience overseeing external laboratories and driving cross-functional CMC initiatives.

jobs.title: Research Associate I/II, Preclinical Research (Contract)
jobs.description_text: Role Summary The Research Associate I/II will support Lexeo’s human induced pluripotent stem cell–derived cardiomyocyte (iPSC-CM) platform, a core in vitro system used to evaluate target engagement, mechanism of action, and potency across discovery and preclinical programs. This hands-on laboratory role will execute established cellular and molecular assays, contribute to assay development, and generate high-quality data. The position reports to the Head of Cardiac Research and receives day-to-day scientific direction from the Preclinical Scientist leading the platform. This is an exciting opportunity to join a cutting-edge drug discovery team advancing new therapies for patients with genetic heart disease while gaining valuable experiences for a future career in biotech and medicine

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, In Vivo Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a hands-on in vivo pharmacologist to build rodent models of cardiac disease and use them to de-risk targets, screen therapeutic candidates and advance our discovery pipeline. The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Modality Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is hiring a hands-on Modality Engineering Scientist to design, synthesize, and characterize oligonucleotides, bioconjugates, and AAV therapeutics for our discovery pipeline. The scientist will advance molecules from design through analytical characterization and handoff to in vitro and in vivo teams, working across chemistry, molecular biology, and pharmacology. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Analytical Development
jobs.description_text: Role Summary This Scientist II will independently design, execute, and analyze research studies and will drive one or more analytical development projects for AAV-based gene therapy programs. The role provides technical leadership in the development, optimization, qualification, validation, and transfer of analytical assays, including cell-based potency and molecular methods such as qPCR and ddPCR. The Scientist II will apply broad scientific knowledge and novel approaches to establish AAV mechanisms of action in cellular systems, resolve moderately complex technical issues, and support GMP manufacturing, material release, and regulatory submissions in collaboration with groups across CMC, Quality, QC, and external partners. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities, and effective in a fast-paced environment. The Scientist II is expected to exercise sound scientific judgment, communicate complex technical issues clearly, build alignment across functions, and serve as a technical resource to colleagues. This is a highly visible and impactful role in our CMC organization. Compensation is dependent on qualifications and experrience

jobs.title: Scientist II, Cellular Neuroscience and Translational Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a highly collaborative, hands-on Scientist II to help establish a preclinical neuroscience laboratory supporting small-molecule and protein therapeutics. The immediate priorities are rapid cellular profiling and lead selection for an advanced small-molecule enzyme program, and leadership of cellular development for a transferrin-based protein replacement project. The role will also build fit-for-purpose human neuronal models, laboratory workflows, and external partnerships. Location We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

jobs.description_text: Long Wall Company was created in 2024 to accelerate missile defense technology for the U.S. and our allies. We specialize in ballistic missile defense and are developing Cyclops, a low-cost, mass-producible interceptor. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. The future of global security depends on defensive technology that redefines cost, magazine depth, and distribution to deter and defend against evolving threats. Join us. WHAT WE LOOK FOR Mission-Driven Problem Solvers– The problems in missile defense demand ingenuity. We want engineers who approach challenges with curiosity, embrace failure as a learning opportunity, and stay focused on delivering the best solution for the mission. Total Ownership– We seek engineers who take full responsibility for delivering flight-ready work while recognizing that no one succeeds alone. The best engineers make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success.

jobs.title: Director, Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East
jobs.description_text: Machina is looking for a Director of Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East to establish and grow our presence with European defense primes, with the opportunity to expand into the Middle East over time. This is our first dedicated international business development role and will operate with significant autonomy. You’ll identify the programs and partners where Machina’s technologies and factories can have the greatest impact, build trusted relationships across European defense companies, and turn those relationships into technical engagements, proof-of-concept programs, qualification programs, and ultimately production opportunities, either fulfilled by Machina factories or deployed at customer sites. This is not a traditional sales role. We’re looking for someone who can operate credibly with engineers, program leaders, manufacturing teams, and senior executives and understands how complex defense systems move from development into production. You will work closely with Machina’s leadership, defense subsidiary, business development, engineering, and manufacturing teams. This is a remote position based in Europe, with significant travel throughout the region and periodic travel to Machina’s headquarters in Los Angeles. Candidates must reside in Europe.

jobs.description_text: Role Overview The AI & Automation Engineer helps teams work smarter by identifying opportunities to automate manual processes and apply AI where it can add meaningful value. Working across Business Applications, Data & Analytics, and IT, you will build practical solutions that simplify work, improve efficiency, and support business outcomes. This role reports to the VP of Business Systems. Please note: This role requires hands-on coding experience, and candidates should be prepared to demonstrate their technical skills during the interview process.

jobs.title: Director, Cloud Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Overview The Director, Cloud Engineering is responsible for the strategy, operation, security, governance, and financial stewardship of Magnet's cloud platform and shared engineering services. This Leader partners closely with Engineering, Product, UX, Security, IT, Compliance, Finance, and Go-to-Market teams to ensure our cloud platform enables rapid product innovation while meeting the highest standards for reliability, security, compliance, and cost efficiency. This role combines technical acumen, operational excellence, cloud strategy, AI enablement, Financial Operations ("FinOps") discipline, vendor management, and organizational leadership. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for ensuring Magnet's cloud platform remains secure, reliable, compliant, cost-effective, and capable of powering the next generation of digital investigation products. NOTE: Candidates must reside in Canada.

jobs.title: Director, Public Sector Sales - LATAM
jobs.description_text: Role Overview Magnet Forensics, a leader in digital forensics solutions, is seeking a dynamic Director of Sales to lead a team of Account Managers covering the LATAM region. This pivotal role is responsible for driving the team to exceed revenue targets and execute the company’s go-to-market strategy. The Director will actively engage in the region to identify, progress, and close strategic opportunities while fostering a high-performance team culture. Collaborating cross-functionally across the Company, the Director will ensure alignment to achieve revenue goals. The ideal candidate is a proven sales leader with exceptional coaching, presentation and selling skills.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive – North Asia
jobs.description_text: Role Overview Magnet Forensics is seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to grow our private-sector business across North Asia. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a strategically important market and play a central role in expanding Magnet Forensics’ enterprise presence across Japan and North Asia. This role will focus on Japan as the primary market and have additional responsibility for South Korea, Taiwan and Hong Kong. The successful candidate will build pipeline, acquire new enterprise customers and expand strategic existing accounts. We are looking for a senior cybersecurity salesperson with strong relationships across the Japanese enterprise market, particularly with CISOs, SOC leaders and incident response teams. They will own complex sales cycles from initial engagement through to close, working with customers, partners, marketing and sales engineering.
